title: EBH-3 gate scans only intergrax/: Tier-2/3 production modules import integrations._shared private modules
affected_invariant: EBH-3: production must not import integrations._shared
impact: 8 non-test files outside intergrax/ (1 under agents/, 7 under applications/) import intergrax.integrations._shared.*; the gate's scan root is intergrax/ only. Present at the cert SHA, so not drift. The stage text reads as repo-wide.
recommendation: Either narrow the stage claim to the platform tree in the roadmap/FRZ text or extend the gate scan root to agents/ and applications/ (with an allowlist).

title: EBH-2E cert-time gap: Gemini, OpenAI Responses and LangChain Ollama stream paths bypassed the provider guard (later PDC D3 HIGH, repaired)
affected_invariant: EBH-2E provider lifecycle/cancellation boundary on provider calls
impact: At the EBH-2E cert SHA three adapters' stream paths used the weaker _provider_dependency_attempt instead of _execute_streaming; PDC D3 (c08efe46) rated it HIGH; commit 8a9c1f797 routes all streams through the guard and the legacy path has no callers at baseline. Not high today. The P8 note says the resilience part of the repair is not real (N-D3-1): read as E1, not verified here.
recommendation: Confirm N-D3-1 in the P8 follow-up; record in the EBH-2E row that the closure predates the D3 repair.

title: ADR3-IMP-03-R1 and IMP-03/M4 cite cert SHAs that predate the consumer migration that rewrote the contract
impact: 805c338 (IMP-04 consumer migration) is not an ancestor of 2555905 or 702cb0a, yet it changed the contract file, executor and wiring.
